{{Quote|Welcome, gentle beings. It is but a short scenic ride to The Lucky Twi'lek... Where all your dreams may come true.|[[Duros/Legends|Duros]] taxi driver|<ref name="SparkRemains">''[[Star Wars: Dark Times—A Spark Remains]]''</ref>}}
'''The Lucky Twi'lek''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] located in the canyons of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kestavel]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. It was run by former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kai Hudorra]]. Large [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] of two scantily [[Clothing/Legends|clad]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|females]] were projected over the entrance. In order to attract potential customers, [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] signage outside the club promised "free [[Alcohol/Legends|drinks]]". Other signs read "love" and "win". The casino also offered luxurious rooms as accommodation.

It was also the site of the [[Ambush at Kestavel|attempted assassination]] of Darth Vader. As Darth Vader approached the building with a squad of stormtroopers, engine fuel was released and flooded the bridge, with a lighter being thrown down, causing a massive blaze that led [[Gregg]] to believe that Vader had been killed.
